edition: 1582 New Testament / 1609-1610 Old Testament JSON dataset

rights_notes: Non-approved candidate manifest only. The source website and repository claim the complete Original Douay-Rheims Bible and CC0/public-domain release. Before import, manually verify the repository owner, exact source commit, transcription provenance, source PDFs, license continuity across all files, and redistribution suitability. Technical staging excludes non-canonical extra source books and a Tobias chapter 0 prologue from normalized Bible chapter data.
format: book-level JSON files under bible/raw/ or bible/tagged/; one file per book with book, book_title, short_title, chapters, verses, notes, and optional cross_refs

excluded_source_records.reason: Non-canonical source prologue or introductory chapter was excluded from normalized Bible chapter data.

importer_compatibility: supported after book-level JSON readiness update; future import must still pass provenance gate
